name: live-streams
description: Provisions CORS-friendly live internet radio (Icecast / Shoutcast HTTP streams) for The Telegraph Ghost's three RX-only broadcasters (89.30 news, 93.50 sports, 98.10 jazz). Finds candidates (curated + the open Radio Browser directory), verifies each one really plays in Web Audio (HTTPS, an audio content type, and Access-Control-Allow-Origin on a GET with an Origin header), and writes src/data/liveStreams.ts.
